project.readme:
# MyScoutee Template

Template backend and frontend delivery, using the portfolio’s standard task, status, effort and usage fields.

[Backend and releases](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template) · [Frontend](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template-frontend) · [Live demo](https://fssrepository.github.io/myscoutee-template-frontend/) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap)

**MSC-122: Done — 1.4.0 published and verified on VMware.**

The MSC-122 issue is shared with MyScoutee. Its 1,134,112,133 tokens / 43.898 h / $1,557.73 Standard API equivalent are already counted in the MyScoutee total; this Project is another view of the same work, not additional usage. The snapshot and measurement references are saved in the roadmap repository.

items.title: MSC-122: Extract reusable UI components and a generic MyScoutee template
items.body:
Delivered **MyScoutee Template 1.4.0** and **MyScoutee Components 1.4.0** on October 12, 2026.

- [x] Separate reusable components and generic application foundations from product-specific domains.
- [x] Keep MyScoutee consuming the same component owners and preserve its qualified behavior.
- [x] Qualify local/HTTP login, consent, profiles, SmartList, chat and retained operator/admin capabilities.
- [x] Qualify monolith/KVM, packaging, signed updates, recovery and publication.
- [x] Install the exact published template DEB on VMware and complete the two-member login/SmartList/chat/logout smoke.
- [x] Publish branded PDF manuals, GitHub Pages and the components npm package.

[Template and documentation](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template) · [Live demo](https://fssrepository.github.io/myscoutee-template-frontend/) · [Template 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/releases/tag/v1.4.0) · [Components 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-components/releases/tag/v1.4.0)

**Checklist: 33/33 tasks and 118/118 subtasks DONE.** Git history, roadmap/account usage and heatmap are updated. The [Template Project](https://github.com/users/fssrepository/projects/6) connects both template repositories. The LinkedIn article, short sharing post and branded cover are committed in the private backend guides. General MyScoutee feature-QA campaigns remain separate.

values.Evidence: Template v1.4.0 published; exact DEB verified on VMware; checklist 1–31 DONE. Usage: 7,830 unique responses through 2026-10-12T18:56:15.981000+00:00; mixed-task attribution estimated; includes tool waits.
